g.text: Interface changes cut Galaxy tokens by more than half, with accuracy unchanged
BixBench-Verified-50. a, b, tokens per complete 50-task run (input including cached context, plus output; mean of 3 runs per task), Galaxy and custom code side by side at each stage;
above each pair: Galaxy ÷ custom code; in the bars: accuracy. c, each task's Galaxy tokens after the changes relative to before (3 runs each, summed); the bar is the median.
d, where the October savings came from: mean input tokens per run by phase (estimated as in the phase figure). Intervals: 95% cluster bootstrap over source capsules.
